attribution.rationale: Old failures are direct expected-category assertions through the public ErrorClassifier.classify API. No collection/import/environment failures occurred. The two resource controls also pass the baseline.

limitations: Text diagnostics remain heuristic; unknown error shapes retain UNKNOWN rather than inferring resource/network failures from isolated keywords.
Old/new proof uses minimal isolated source trees containing the byte-identical affected production module and test; repository integration is covered separately by the 61-test run.
